method: Frozen Round465 full-match diagnostic vs Max Damage. Same 256 generated team-pair clusters, previews, repeat indices, and side swaps in both arms; two outcome repeats per cluster. Candidate replaces only the evaluated checkpoint’s first joint action with the Max Damage action; Round465 controls every later decision. Cluster bootstrap pairs by team cluster because Showdown battle RNG is server-side and not identical between arms.
conclusion: Suggestive but inconclusive. This is a single-opponent intervention diagnostic, not a robust policy improvement. No checkpoint or default move selection changed; the PPO win-probability head remains auxiliary and is not used to rank actions.
